_notes: What happened on the order's feast, one line rolled per feast per week and appended to 'The feast of X this week.' (systems/religious/feasts.ts). Keys are OrderDef.feasts keys, or house_patron; `rank` holds fallbacks by rank.

dominic: The founder's day: the province's men who could come came, the Mass had the bishop in choir or his letter on the board, and the cook had planned the dinner for a month.
St. Dominic's day, and the Salve sung at the end of Compline with the whole house on its feet and the visitors trying to find the tune.
The solemnity of the founder. A friar who had left came back for the Mass and stood at the back, and two of the older men went down to him afterwards.
thomas_aquinas: Thomas's day: a public lecture at the studium by a visiting professor, a Mass for the students, and the Summa left open on the lectern.
The Angelic Doctor's feast, and the students' Mass, and a dinner at which the questions were better than the answers.
Thomas's day, and the prior reading the Pange Lingua at table, and the novices realising who wrote it.
catherine_siena: Catherine's day, and the Dominican laity filled the front pews, and the sisters sent flowers with a note that was not entirely about flowers.
The feast of Catherine, and a woman of the lay fraternity read the Dialogue at the Mass with more conviction than the friars usually manage.
rosary: The rosary procession went around the block with the confraternity's banner, and the neighbourhood watched from its porches.
Our Lady of the Rosary, and the confraternity's older members in the front, and their rosaries blessed again, as they are every year.
martin_de_porres: Martin's day: the poor of the neighbourhood fed at the priory door, and the brother who runs the kitchen not to be spoken to before noon.
The feast of Martin de Porres, and a Mass in Spanish and English that was fuller than either would have been.
albert_great: Albert's day, and a Mass for the scientists among the university's Catholics, three of whom came, one with a question.
The feast of Albert, and a lecture on the natural sciences that the lector had been asked to keep short and did not.
augustine: The father's day: the province's men, the Mass, the Confessions read at table instead of the usual, and the better wine.
St. Augustine's day, and the Tolle, lege read at Mass, and a novice in tears at it who would not say why.
The solemnity of Augustine. The bishop came, or his vicar general, and stayed for the dinner, and the house was on its best behaviour until dessert.
monica: Monica's day, and the mothers of the parish at the Mass in numbers, some of them with sons to pray for.
The feast of Monica, and the Mass for mothers, and a woman who asked afterwards for a Mass for a son who has not spoken to her in six years.
conversion_augustine: The Conversion: the garden in Milan read at the Mass, and the novices asked afterwards what it was that Augustine heard.
The feast of the Conversion, and the professed renewing their vows quietly at the end of the Mass, as the custom is in this province.
good_counsel: Good Counsel's day, with the image garlanded and a novena that ended in it and a crowd that came for the novena and stayed.
Our Mother of Good Counsel, and the confraternity's Mass, and a lunch at which somebody's daughter's engagement was announced.
rita: Rita's day: roses blessed at every Mass, and a line of people with impossible cases and roses to carry home.
The feast of Rita, and the church full of people the parish never sees, each with a rose and a reason.
nicholas_tolentino: Nicholas's day: the bread blessed and given out in small bags, and an old woman who takes three, for the sick.
The feast of Nicholas of Tolentino, and the blessing of the bread, and the sick of the parish remembered by name.
consolation: Consolation's day, with the cinctures blessed and the confraternity's older members in their places.
house_patron: The house kept its own patron: the church full of the neighbourhood, a better dinner, and the prior's toast.
The house's patronal feast, and the neighbours in, and the friars at the door afterwards like a family seeing off guests.
dominican_dead: The dead of the Order remembered, and the house's own dead read out from the necrology by the youngest professed, who stumbled on a name and was helped.
The Order's dead, and the necrology, and the older men knowing who the names were.
augustinian_dead: The dead of the Order remembered at the Mass, and the house's own read out from the necrology, and a silence after one name that everyone in the house understood.
The Order's dead, and the necrology, and the prior's own novice master among the names this year.

solemnity: A solemnity of the Order: the Mass with the province's guests, and a dinner with the better wine.
The Order's solemnity, and the house full, and the Salve at the end of the day.
feast: A feast of the Order: the Mass sung, the office kept in full, and a dinner with something on the table that is not usually there.
The Order's feast, kept at the Mass and at table.
memorial: A memorial of the Order, kept at the Mass and noted at table.
The day kept in the calendar and the office, and a word about the saint at Compline.
